depiction.primary_object: curved right-pointing arrow with double arrowhead
modifiers: second leading chevron at arrow tip
depiction.composition: single curved directional arrow turning from vertical to horizontal right

readings.meaning: delegate or pass along to someone else

ambiguity: Easily confused with a standard single-headed forward/share arrow, a redo icon, or a road navigation right-turn symbol, especially at small sizes where the second chevron merges with the first.

modifier_semantics.modifier: second leading chevron at arrow tip
modifier_semantics.meaning: multiple items (forward all), faster movement, or further redirection

reasoning: This icon is an abstract interface arrow ('forward all' or 'skip/redirect') with no concrete object. Almost any real task involving forwarding or redirecting has a clearer central subject (such as an email envelope, phone call, document, or package), and at list sizes this glyph is easily confused with generic share, redo, or turn arrows.
